snippet.title: Break The Chain - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
THE ULTIMATE TEST OF COORDINATION.

How far can you go when you’re literally chained to your partner? ⛓️🤝

Break The Chain is a physics-based cooperative puzzle game where timing is everything and one wrong move can pull everyone down. Navigate through challenging environments, solve intricate puzzles, and master the art of precise movement to earn your freedom.

Play SOLO to test your own limits or jump into CO-OP to see if your friendships can survive the climb.

🎮 WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395930/Break_The_Chain/

Bound Together: Unique physics-based movement where players are connected by a chain.

Challenging Puzzles: Environmental obstacles that require smart thinking and steady hands.

Solo & Co-op Modes: Tackle the challenge alone or coordinate with a friend.

Earned Success: No combat, just pure skill and persistence.

Connect With Us:
X (Twitter): https://x.com/BreakChainDevlo
Discord: https://discord.gg/DjsrFxHpR5


#BreakTheChain #IndieGame #Gaming #CoopGames #PhysicsPuzzle #SteamGames #GameTrailer #DevloGames
